statement: For a split prime p ≡ 1 mod 3 and the matching branch residue r, the Eisenstein valuation is exact: v_{pi_r}(q-ω)=n iff q ≡ r mod p^n but not mod p^(n+1), and similarly v_{pi_r}(q+ω)=n on the Phi6 branch. Equivalently, the exact split-prime exponent in Phi3(q) or Phi6(q) is the exact Hensel depth of q on the chosen branch.
